explanation: Matches Tang's resolution as reported on erdosproblems.com/1044. Admissible f are the monic products of (z - z_i) with n ≥ 1 and |z_i| ≤ 1. Λ(f) is the supremum, over points of {|f| < 1}, of the 1-dimensional Hausdorff measure of the frontier of the connected component, which equals the maximum boundary length over the components. The statement asserts that 2 is the greatest lower bound of these values in ℝ≥0∞.
